title: LSR: Linguistic Safety Robustness Benchmark for Low-Resource West African Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual refusal degradation by submitting matched harmful attack probes in English and four low-resource West African languages (Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, and Igala) to the same model, and quantifying the loss of safety behavior using a metric called Refusal Centroid Drift (RCD).

Testing model safety alignment using culturally grounded harmful requests natively written in target languages with culturally familiar framings (e.g., traditional medicine, local royal authority figures, folklore) to see if safety intent recognition generalizes across non-Western cultural contexts.
